criteria.adapter_cancel: An explicit cancel operation marks the upload handle cancelled and releases the native sink without calling end, so the key never materializes; operations after cancel fail with a state error, and orphaned server-side parts are documented as bucket-lifecycle concern rather than adapter-enforced cleanup.
criteria.delete_on_cancel: Cancelling additionally deletes the object key, which removes any pre-existing object stored under the same key.
criteria.drop_only: No cancel operation exists; callers abandon uploads by dropping the handle, which releases the sink without end and leaves the key absent, but no explicit close runs and no post-abandon state error is defined.

cancel.instructions: How should Can expose cancellation of a multipart upload?

criteria.custom_signer: The adapter implements SigV4 signing itself to bind required headers, duplicating native signing logic inside the adapter.
criteria.emulate_via_type: The content-type option is presented as a required header, even though probes show a mismatched Content-Type still succeeds, certifying policy the service does not enforce.
criteria.method_negatives: The contract pins the enforced negatives, method swaps and signature tampering, both failing closed, while required headers stay unrepresentable and are recorded as a target gap.

signed_headers.instructions: How should the contract treat required headers on presigned URLs?

criteria.epoch_millis: Stat and list entries expose last-modified time as integer epoch milliseconds.
criteria.iso_string: Stat and list entries expose last-modified time as ISO-8601 strings.
criteria.opaque_instant: Stat and list entries expose last-modified time as time::instant handles converted with time::instant_from_epoch_millis.

timestamps.instructions: How should object timestamps cross into Can values?

state: Can compiles to TypeScript executed on pinned Bun 1.4.2 (bun-1.4.2-darwin-arm64-v1, revision 744846f844374847c902b5e7fd59b4342a51ef99). B1-10 adds S3 object storage over the native S3Client, qualified live against MinIO; the adapter lives in runtime/platform/s3.ts behind one emitter binding and must stay thin (native operations only, no adapter-side SigV4). Pinned probes observe: presign takes expiresIn, method and type with no required-headers option; signed URLs carry X-Amz-Algorithm/Credential/Date/Expires/Signature/SignedHeaders and never leak the secret; GET round-trips 200; swapping the method (PUT URL fetched with GET, GET URL fetched with PUT) answers 403; a tampered X-Amz-Signature answers 403 and a tampered PUT creates nothing; a typed PUT executed with a different Content-Type still answers 200 (content type unenforced); expiresIn at or below zero throws TypeError, as does a method outside GET, PUT, DELETE and HEAD; a signed GET for a missing key answers 404; signed DELETE round-trips 204 with the key gone; signed HEAD answers 200 with content length. The upload writer is a NetworkSink exposing write, flush, end and close with no abort; partSize below 5242880 throws RangeError; end returns the uploaded byte count, not an etag; writes after end are silently dropped while end stays idempotent; a writer released via close without end leaves the key absent; an empty writer ends at 0 with a zero-byte object. Ranged downloads slice exact bytes, but slice(n,n) returns the single byte at n rather than empty; reader.cancel ends a download stream. Stat fields are non-enumerable; etags stay quoted with a -N suffix for multipart; lastModified is a Date; text content types gain a charset suffix on store while a Blob type is ignored. Listing pages via maxKeys with isTruncated plus a nextContinuationToken round-trip without overlap; delimiter groups keys under commonPrefixes; entries carry key, eTag, lastModified, size and storageClass; empty prefixes list zero entries. Missing keys answer exists false, size null and unlink/delete true, while stat, text, bytes, json and stream throw S3Error NoSuchKey; wrong credentials throw S3Error UnknownError; a missing bucket surfaces as NoSuchKey; a refused endpoint throws S3Error ConnectionRefused. The catalogue already offers time::instant_from_epoch_millis and time::instant_epoch_millis.
